description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
This release makes full access live up to its name. Tasks are no longer confined to workspace directories or saved directory grants, and commands run directly on the host without sandbox network isolation. Available tool operations—including file and credential access, commands, network requests, and MCP calls—are automatically approved, aligning the mode's actual capabilities with its meaning.
We also refined everyday interactions and polished a few details to make Lexora easier to use.
